environment_secrets.missing_mongo_behavior: Scan history storage is unavailable and the scan returns a safe error before sandbox processing.
environment_secrets.missing_virustotal_behavior: Optional integration returns status disabled and makes no VirusTotal request.

access_control.boundary: Shared application token; not per-user or enterprise authentication.

screenshot_lifecycle.failed_scan_cleanup: Removes screenshot when a later scan operation fails.
screenshot_lifecycle.clear_history_cleanup: Deletes only screenshot references resolving to expected UUID PNG names inside the designated screenshot directory.
screenshot_lifecycle.cleanup_failure_behavior: Logged and counted; history clear remains successful after database deletion.

retention.orphan_cleanup: Only unreferenced UUID screenshots older than configured retention are removed.

logging.full_url_avoidance: URL-validation failures log exception type rather than exception text; worker network-block logs omit blocked URLs.
logging.residual: Operational logs and exception stacks may exist; sink, retention, and provider handling are deployment concerns not established here.

history_document_fields.final_url: resolved destination display and analysis context
history_document_fields.title: result/history identification

stored_data_and_purpose.boundary: URLs, titles, query strings, screenshots, reasons, and external results can still contain sensitive information.

external_transmission.sandbox: Validated URL is processed in the short-lived browser sandbox; HTML is not stored in the successful history document.
external_transmission.virustotal: Final URL is sent only when VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY is configured.

manual_actions_required: Revoke/rotate the historically exposed MongoDB credential.
Revoke/rotate the historically exposed VirusTotal credential.
Provide replacement values and QRSHIELD_API_TOKEN through deployment environment or a secret manager.
Do not treat this as a claim about Git history, backups, infrastructure, third parties, encryption at rest, or legal compliance.

decision.basis: Implemented controls plus focused tests and disclosure support the scoped proposal requirement; manual credential rotation remains explicitly outstanding.
